| f7 | defect | MINOR | The G3 `gitCommonDir` contract has a fallback arm on the Rust side that the TS side can never match. But TS `GitRepositoryAdapter.gitCommonDir` returns `null` for a non-repo, `selectByRepository` (core/discovery.ts:96) then returns `{gitCommonDir: null, descriptors: []}`, and `mergeSessionRows` maps a null scope to `[]`.
